prd.description: SPU Tracking System with barcode scanning assembly workflow, particle serial to UDI linking, parts/lot traceability, electronic signatures, and TRON-style UI. Compliant with ISO 13485 and FDA 21 CFR Part 820.

tasks.title: Add batch table to database schema
tasks.description: As a production manager, I want a batch table to group SPUs manufactured together for traceability and recall capability
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'integer' import to drizzle-orm/pg-core imports in schema.ts
Add 'batch' table with: id (text PK), batchNumber (text unique), description, targetQuantity (integer), startedAt, completedAt, createdAt, createdBy (FK to user)
tasks.notes: Completed 2026-01-23. db:push skipped (no database connected in dev).

tasks.title: Add spu table to database schema
tasks.description: As a production operator, I want an SPU table to track individual Sample Processing Units with their UDI and status
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'spu' table with: id (text PK), udi (text unique), status (text default 'draft'), batchId (FK to batch), assembledBy (FK to user), assemblyStartedAt, assemblyCompletedAt, assemblySignatureId (text), createdAt, createdBy (FK to user), updatedAt

tasks.title: Add particle_link table for serial to UDI mapping
tasks.description: As a production operator, I want to link particle serial numbers (MSOM units) to SPU UDIs with one-to-one relationship
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'particleLink' table with: id (text PK), spuId (FK to spu, unique), particleSerial (text unique), particleDeviceId (text), linkedAt, linkedBy (FK to user), previousSpuId (text), unlinkReason (text)
Unique constraints on spuId and particleSerial ensure one-to-one mapping

tasks.title: Add part_definition table for master parts list
tasks.description: As a production engineer, I want a master list of part definitions that go into assembling an SPU
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'partDefinition' table with: id (text PK), partNumber (text unique), name (text), description, category, scanRequired (boolean default true), sortOrder (integer default 0), isActive (boolean default true), createdAt, updatedAt

tasks.title: Add spu_part table for device history records
tasks.description: As a quality manager, I want to track which parts (with lot numbers) went into each SPU for full traceability and recall support
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'spuPart' table with: id (text PK), spuId (FK to spu), partDefinitionId (FK to partDefinition), lotNumber (text), serialNumber (text), scannedAt, scannedBy (FK to user), barcodeData (text), isReplaced (boolean default false), replacedBy (text), replaceReason (text)
tasks.notes: Completed 2026-01-23. DHR table for device history records.

tasks.title: Add assembly_session table for workflow tracking
tasks.description: As a production operator, I want assembly sessions tracked so I can pause, resume, and complete assembly workflows
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'assemblySession' table with: id (text PK), spuId (FK to spu), userId (FK to user), status (text default 'in_progress'), currentStepIndex (integer default 0), startedAt, pausedAt, completedAt, workstationId (text), notes (text)

tasks.title: Add electronic_signature table for 21 CFR Part 11 compliance
tasks.description: As a quality manager, I want electronic signatures captured for assembly completion to meet FDA compliance requirements
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'electronicSignature' table with: id (text PK), userId (FK to user), entityType (text), entityId (text), meaning (text), signedAt, ipAddress (text), userAgent (text), dataHash (text)

tasks.title: Add part and assembly permission resources
tasks.description: As an admin, I want permission resources for parts and assembly so I can control access to these features
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'part' and 'assembly' to PermissionResource type in src/lib/server/auth/permissions.ts

tasks.title: Add TRON theme CSS custom properties

Add .tron-grid-bg class with grid background pattern
CSS loads without errors in browser
